## Why GPL-3.0-or-later

The plugin statically links CommonLibOB64 (https://github.com/libxse/commonlibob64) and its commonlib-shared
library (https://github.com/libxse/commonlib-shared), both GPL-3.0; the modding exception that comes with the plugin
template is kept in the source repository as `EXCEPTIONS`.

The storage plugin `SimpleLoadoutSystem.esp` is this mod's own: one interior cell, ten chest references of the
game's own chest base and one global - no record of the game's is copied or edited.

Components under other licences, with their notices: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
